set.body: Objective: replace the 69-file flat scalafim.multivar namespace with a shallow, dependency-directed hierarchy for core algebra, optimization, lifecycle, fitted capabilities, family verticals, selection, and evidence. Preserve all mathematical distinctions and numerical behavior; split misplaced ownership and oversized compilation units where it clarifies the algebra; keep source compatibility through a deliberate root facade during migration; update tests, downstream imports, module docs, and architecture enforcement. Acceptance: generic lifecycle no longer depends upward on ModelSpec; family receipts live beside their adapters; no production Scala file remains in an undifferentiated flat source directory except the curated facade; JVM and Scala.js focused/module/IR/full-repository gates pass; commit is merged into main through a clean worktree without disturbing the shared checkout.
set.title: Restructure multivar into layered algebraic packages
